title: 第十七章 进度飞快第十八章 破限点满
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
夕阳西下，演武场拉出长长的影子。
苏羽收势，长吐一口白气。
【熟练度+1】
【熟练度+1】
……
这种日积月累的熟练度增加，让他心无旁骛。
马飞那边则不然，走桩半途，经常眼神愤恨的看向内院。
“凭什么？就因为他有个铁匠爹？”马飞啐了一口，转头看向剩下的三人，“行了，王虎当人上人去了，咱们这些苦命鬼还得干活。”
说罢，马飞已经抢过扫帚，装模作样地扫起了最轻松的前院。
武馆的杂活很多，每日需要清扫地面，擦拭保养铁桩，兵器，帮助刘大婶捣药熬制汤药，还有巡夜，倒夜香…
其中倒夜香最脏，捣药最累，内院的活也普遍比外院累，马飞率先抢了清扫外院的活，意思不言而喻。
苏羽不想浪费时间跟他计较，正要前去茅厕倒夜香。
陈凡倒是率先一步，冲上前去，“我来，我来，两位师兄干些别的吧，这种活交给我就行。”
苏羽点点头，若有所思的往内院走去。
内院，师兄们都已离开武馆，只留下空荡荡的院子，散落一地兵器。
苏羽挨个收拾起来，发现大多都是精铁兵器，刀剑为主。
自己还没练过兵器，不知道以后学点什么好。
放好兵器，检查木桩，缠麻绳，上油，处理起来颇为麻烦。
全部收拾完，已经半个时辰过去。
刘大婶正好从药房出来，吆喝人帮忙。

“大姐，我来。”苏羽连忙向前。
“苏羽啊，怎么就你一个人，这活可累的很。”
“不碍事，大姐，我先干着。”苏羽跟着她进入药房。
药房中央摆着一个半人高的青石巨臼，里面堆满了各种药材。
“你先捣着，累了就去前院再喊人来。”说完，刘大婶离开了药房。
苏羽提起那根很重的石杵。
“咚！”
沉闷的撞击声回荡在狭小的空间里。
每一次提起、落下，苏羽都感觉手臂肌肉一阵酸麻震颤，看样子这个活果然没有那么轻松。
不过苏羽没有丝毫偷懒，认真的干着。
刘大婶偶尔进来看下，发现苏羽尽职尽责，没有丝毫偷懒，也是满意的点点头。
半个时辰后，药材终于捣好了，苏羽赤裸的上身，也是汗水直流，顺着他明显的肌肉线条，不断滴落在地上。
这具身体已经养好了许多，再也不是刚来时的瘦弱了。
这时，刘大婶进来，检查了一番，非常满意，“干的不错！大婶就喜欢你这样的小伙子，做事认真，不偷懒！”
content_en:
As the sun sets, long shadows are cast across the martial arts arena.
Su Yu stopped his momentum and let out a long breath of white air.
[Proficiency +1]
[Proficiency +1]
…
This accumulated proficiency increased over time, allowing him to focus on nothing else.
Ma Fei's side was different. Halfway through the walk, he often looked towards the inner courtyard with angry eyes.
"Why? Just because he has a blacksmith father?" Ma Fei spat, turning to look at the remaining three people, "Okay, Wang Hu has become a master, and we poor people still have to work."
Having said that, Ma Fei had already grabbed the broom and pretended to sweep the front yard with ease.
There are many chores in the martial arts studio. Every day, you need to clean the floor, wipe and maintain the iron piles and weapons, help Aunt Liu pound medicine and make soup, watch the night, pour night incense...
Among them, pouring night fragrance is the dirtiest, and pounding medicine is the most tiring. The work in the inner courtyard is generally more tiring than that in the outer courtyard. Ma Fei took the lead in taking the job of cleaning the outer courtyard, which is self-evident.
Su Yu didn't want to waste time arguing with him, and was about to go to the toilet to pour night fragrance.
Chen Fan took the lead and rushed forward, "I'll come, I'll come. Brothers, please do something else. Just leave this kind of work to me."
Su Yu nodded and walked thoughtfully towards the inner courtyard.
In the inner courtyard, the senior brothers had all left the martial arts hall, leaving only an empty courtyard with weapons scattered everywhere.
Su Yu picked them up one by one and found that most of them were fine iron weapons, mainly swords.
I haven't practiced weapons yet, so I don't know what to learn in the future.
It was quite troublesome to put away the weapons, check the wooden stakes, wrap the hemp ropes, and oil them.
After finishing everything, half an hour has passed.
Aunt Liu happened to come out of the pharmacy and asked for help.
"Sister, I'm coming." Su Yu hurried forward.
"Su Yu, why are you alone? This work is very tiring."
"It's okay, sister, I'll do it first." Su Yu followed her into the pharmacy.
In the center of the pharmacy stands a giant bluestone mortar half as tall as a man, which is filled with various medicinal materials.
"You pound it first, and when you're tired, go to the front yard and call for help." After saying that, Aunt Liu left the pharmacy.
Su Yu lifted up the heavy stone pestle.
"Boom!"
The dull crashing sound echoed in the small space.
Every time he lifted or dropped it, Su Yu felt a numbness and tremor in his arm muscles. It seemed that this job was not that easy after all.
However, Su Yu was not lazy at all and worked seriously.
Aunt Liu occasionally came in to take a look and found that Su Yu was doing his duty without any laziness, so she nodded with satisfaction.
Half an hour later, the medicinal ingredients were finally ready. Su Yu's naked upper body was dripping with sweat, dripping to the ground along his obvious muscle lines.
This body has healed a lot and is no longer as thin as when it first arrived.
At this time, Aunt Liu came in, inspected it, and was very satisfied, "Well done! Auntie likes young men like you, who work hard and don't be lazy!"
